|---|-----|-----|

|---|-----|-----|

| 5 | `ImportByWildcard*=false` blocks NuGet package hook injection | Removed the suppression |
| 6 | `CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` in `.targets` — same timing issue | Moved to `.props` |
| 7 | `GenerateAssemblyInfo` shadows the SDK's built-in target | Renamed to `GenerateCustomAssemblyInfo` |
| 8 | `AfterTargets="_CopyFilesMarkedCopyLocal"` uses internal target | Changed to public `CopyFilesToOutputDirectory` |
